Module com.univalle.sudoku
Package com.example.sudoku.events

Class CellEventAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.events.CellEventAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ICellEventListener
public abstract class CellEventAdapter extends Object implements ICellEventListener
Abstract adapter for ICellEventListener. Provides empty default implementations for all event callback methods, allowing concrete subclasses to override only the events they care about.

Following the Adapter design pattern, inner-class handlers in the controller extend this class instead of directly implementing ICellEventListener, reducing boilerplate.
